additional_info.subject: Reports amount of disconnections on the OCPP side from AWS
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I would like to receive reports for OCPP disconnections (offline) in the range of the last month from 01/12/24-07/01/25 for the following charging positions:
1. 170002066
2. 170002067
3. 170002065
4. 170002064
5. 170002068
The customer claims that they have offline problems on the part of the OCPP on the SCB side, the number of disconnections they indicate is illogical and I have not seen a mention of talking to the SCB.
I would love to receive an orderly report on the availability percentages of these charging stations, the number of disconnections that occurred in the time frame I specified with dates and hours.
Thank you for your support, it is very important.
Br,
Orel

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398326-DC/Si-D/IL-[Multiple] Disconnections on the OCPP side from AWS CRM:01410001368
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel,
I can see that for the charger Ly5YuF, the Unavailable status has appeared once in the last 24hrs (see attached photo).
The reason for the charger being unavailable is DC2 Errorcode:6 and DC2 Errorcode:20 (see 2nd photo). These both are insulation monitoring errors, which can generally occur after a charging session, which is the case here.
Since the “Unavailable” has occurred only once, we can narrow down the issue is that of LEM meter. Hence, I would request you to check the LEM meter wiring on the charger for both meters. Photos 3 and 4 show the wiring which is to be checked. If the wiring was found ok, then please carry a spare LEM meter and install it instead of the old ones. After that we will monitor the charger again for 24hr to see if the fault re-appears.
For the remaining chargers, I will do the log analysis for “Unavailable” status and update you on the same as soon as I can.
For future reference, your case number is 0398326, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe

additional_info.subject: @NOC team
additional_info.body:
For Ly5YuF, charger was getting unavailable status, because of response timeout to LEM address. We asked RC to remove the LEM address from the charger and test if the unavailable status re-occurs, in the 24hrs it did not reoccur, hence we concluded that both LEM meter wiring is to be checked and a spare LEM meter is to be test on the charger.
For the remaining dIa2Ty, QwSt1v, DTVyFK, 4JORRs chargers, please check if it is the same scenario where the LEM address response timeout is causing theCP status to become unavailable. If so please ask the RC to check wiring of LEM cables for these chargers as well.
